title: TrueRise tool-call envelope (RFC 0002)
description: The act-payload envelope a model may emit to request one tool execution. The loop parses this shape only when tool hooks are wired; everything else is plain text and never executes.

tool.description: Tool name (e.g. write_file / read_file); anything outside the sandbox's action set is refused

args.description: Tool arguments; string-valued (paths are fenced by the sandbox provider)
